gloss: to read through; to finish reading (a book)

definitions.gloss: to read through; to finish reading (a lengthy or difficult work)
definitions.explanation: To read a book or text from beginning to end, especially one that is long, challenging, or requires effort. Implies accomplishment and perseverance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長編小説|ちょうへんしょうせつ}→長編小説：20799_chouhenshousetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読破|どくは}した。
examples.english: I finished reading a long novel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{全巻|ぜんかん}→全巻：17073_zenkan⟧⟦{読破|どくは}→読破：19606_dokuha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
examples.english: I aim to read through all the volumes during summer vacation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{難解|なんかい}→難解：15231_nankai⟧な{哲学書|てつがくしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧か{月|げつ}⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧{読破|どくは}した。
examples.english: I spent three months reading through a difficult philosophy book.

notes:
Composed of {読|どく} (read) + {破|は} (break through). The {破|は} element conveys the idea of pushing through to completion, suggesting effort and determination. Used primarily for books, series, or other substantial reading material.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{全巻|ぜんかん}→全巻：17073_zenkan⟧⟦{読破|どくは}→読破：19606_dokuha⟧: reading through all volumes
- ⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{読破|どくは}する: to read through in one sitting
- ⟦{長編|ちょうへん}→長編：14475_chouhen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{読破|どくは}する: to finish reading a long work
- ⟦{読破|どくは}→読破：19606_dokuha⟧⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧: reading goal (number of books to finish)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {読了|どくりょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to finish reading — more neutral, simply means reaching the end without the "pushing through" nuance
- ⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦{終|お}える→終える：02019_oeru⟧: to finish reading — the plain everyday expression
- ⟦{完読|かんどく}→完読：22581_kandoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to read completely — similar but less common
